# Single data qubit error test set  T_1^x   (distance d = 7)
# n = 49 data qubits, p = 24 X-stabilizers
# Row q : syndrome of the X-stabilizers produced by a single Z-error on data qubit q
# Bit string is LSB-first: leftmost character is stabilizer x0, rightmost is x23
#
#  qubit  syndrome bits             fired stabilizers
  q0      100000000000000000000000  x0
  q1      100000000000000000000000  x0
  q2      010000000000000000000000  x1
  q3      010000000000000000000000  x1
  q4      001000000000000000000000  x2
  q5      001000000000000000000000  x2
  q6      000000000000000000100000  x18
  q7      100000000000000000010000  x0 x19
  q8      100100000000000000000000  x0 x3
  q9      010100000000000000000000  x1 x3
  q10     010010000000000000000000  x1 x4
  q11     001010000000000000000000  x2 x4
  q12     001001000000000000000000  x2 x5
  q13     000001000000000000100000  x5 x18
  q14     000000100000000000010000  x6 x19
  q15     000100100000000000000000  x3 x6
  q16     000100010000000000000000  x3 x7
  q17     000010010000000000000000  x4 x7
  q18     000010001000000000000000  x4 x8
  q19     000001001000000000000000  x5 x8
  q20     000001000000000000001000  x5 x20
  q21     000000100000000000000100  x6 x21
  q22     000000100100000000000000  x6 x9
  q23     000000010100000000000000  x7 x9
  q24     000000010010000000000000  x7 x10
  q25     000000001010000000000000  x8 x10
  q26     000000001001000000000000  x8 x11
  q27     000000000001000000001000  x11 x20
  q28     000000000000100000000100  x12 x21
  q29     000000000100100000000000  x9 x12
  q30     000000000100010000000000  x9 x13
  q31     000000000010010000000000  x10 x13
  q32     000000000010001000000000  x10 x14
  q33     000000000001001000000000  x11 x14
  q34     000000000001000000000010  x11 x22
  q35     000000000000100000000001  x12 x23
  q36     000000000000100100000000  x12 x15
  q37     000000000000010100000000  x13 x15
  q38     000000000000010010000000  x13 x16
  q39     000000000000001010000000  x14 x16
  q40     000000000000001001000000  x14 x17
  q41     000000000000000001000010  x17 x22
  q42     000000000000000000000001  x23
  q43     000000000000000100000000  x15
  q44     000000000000000100000000  x15
  q45     000000000000000010000000  x16
  q46     000000000000000010000000  x16
  q47     000000000000000001000000  x17
  q48     000000000000000001000000  x17
#
# Degenerate classes (qubits sharing an identical syndrome):
#   {q0, q1}  ->  100000000000000000000000
#   {q2, q3}  ->  010000000000000000000000
#   {q4, q5}  ->  001000000000000000000000
#   {q43, q44}  ->  000000000000000100000000
#   {q45, q46}  ->  000000000000000010000000
#   {q47, q48}  ->  000000000000000001000000
